## 2026-01-23 - Defer File Existence Checks
**Learning:** When listing items from a large directory (e.g. 50k runs), checking file existence (`os.path.exists`) for every item is a significant bottleneck, even if the check is fast.
**Action:** Sort candidates by cached metadata (e.g. mtime from `os.scandir`) first, then only perform expensive checks (like file existence or loading content) on the top N results that will actually be returned.
## 2024-05-18 - Optimize directory listing
**Learning:** When listing run directories for SpecManager, sorting `Path` objects generated by `iterdir()` is slow for large numbers of runs because of path instantiation overhead. Using `os.scandir()` to extract string names and then sorting them is significantly faster.
**Action:** Extract string names from `os.scandir` before sorting to avoid the overhead of sorting `Path` objects when scanning directories with many entries.
